{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders again after parsing
df_qa = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders after parsing: {len(df_qa)}')

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[~(df['revenue'] == 999999.99)]
print(f'Rows after removing QA orders: {len(df_clean)}')

# Now check refunded orders
df_refunded = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Refunded orders after filtering: {len(df_refunded)}')

# Remove refunded orders
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Rows after removing refunded orders: {len(df_final)}')

# Check conversion rate by segment
df_conv = df_final.groupby('customer_segment', as_index=False)['converted'].mean()
df_conv = df_conv.sort_values('converted', ascending=False)
print(f'Conversion rates by segment (sorted):\n{df_conv}')

# Return the top segment
top_segment = df_conv.iloc[0]['customer_segment']
print(f'Top segment: {top_segment}')"}
